items.gating_reason: blocked_substrate (corrected 2026-07-21, session loving-banach-31d3c4). PREVIOUS STATUS 'executed' WAS FALSE and self-perpetuating: the indexer carries any non-'proposed' status forward by backlog_id, so it could never self-correct. V3-EXQ-683 NEVER RAN. It was queued twice on 2026-06-17 (ree-v3 commits 75f9883c5c and 0e185801ff) and both times was silently BURNED by the pre-fix coordinator terminal-row upsert defect -- the phase3-queue snapshot deleted the freshly-committed entry within ~1-3 minutes. Verified 2026-07-21: NO manifest and NO run directory exists for the stem v3_exq_683_mech048_mu_kappa_stability_probe anywhere under evidence/experiments/, and claim_evidence.v1.json shows MECH-048 with exp=0 entries / experimental_confidence 0.0 (4 lit entries, lit_conf 0.837, quadrant plausible_unproven). NOT re-offered as 'proposed', because the proposal as scripted is DEFINITIONALLY CIRCULAR as a test of MECH-048. ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_683_mech048_mu_kappa_stability_probe.py modulates action-selection temperature (mu 0.5 / baseline 1.0 / kappa 2.0) and then scores C1/C2 on action entropy -- and its 'action_entropy_mean' is literally the mean of H(softmax(scores / temperature)) computed at the selection site (script lines 166-169, 231-234). Raising T raises that entropy by the arithmetic of the softmax. So a PASS would credit experimental confidence to MECH-048 for an identity, and a FAIL would falsely weaken it -- neither is evidence about opponent stability overlays. The circularity is forced by substrate absence, not by a fixable script bug: NO mu/kappa control-plane overlay exists in ree_core. grep -rn kappa ree-v3/ree_core/ returns ONLY SD-057's incentive_drive_kappa_weight / incentive_drive_kappa_scale in goal.py (the Zhang-2009 drive->wanting coupling weight, wanting[k] = base_value[k] * (1 + kappa_weight * drive_axis[k])) -- an unrelated drive-coupling term, not a stability/entropy modulator over control-plane regimes. There is nothing to perturb, so temperature was substituted as a proxy, and the proxy is the tautology. MECH-048 therefore has no testable substrate today. Sibling precedent for proxy-forced-by-absence: EVB-0091/MECH-191, EVB-0341/MECH-088, EVB-0102-class sleep blocks. No build chip spawned: the fix is upstream /implement-substrate construction of the overlay, not another lettered iteration.

It is the type-specificity corollary of INV-050, and strictly HARDER than its already-blocked sibling MECH-180 (EVB-0102 sibling; MECH-180 held v3_pending after V3-EXQ-677 established the substrate cannot vary sleep by PE LOAD -- MECH-179 additionally needs variation by PE TYPE). Substrate-blocked on THREE independent counts (verified 2026-07-04): (1) NO error-TYPE channel exists -- grep of ree-v3/ree_core for mel_type|error_type|emotional_error|episodic_error|phase_specific returns ZERO hits. There is no representation that tags an episode's error as world-model (episodic/spatial/factual) vs policy-salience (emotional/social/identity), so 'type' -- the entire independent variable of MECH-179 -- cannot be set. The 'emotional/social/identity error' side has no genuine substrate: no social prediction-error channel, no emotional-PE channel; only a loose E2 harm/self-model proxy. (2) NO phase-DEMAND mechanism -- sleep phase composition is FIXED and scheduler-pinned. phase_manager.py walks WAKING->SWS_ANALOG->REM_ANALOG every cycle unconditionally; V3-EXQ-677 (failure_autopsy 2026-06-14, confirmed) measured SWS=80/REM=60 with ZERO cross-arm variance -- the counts derive from sleep_interval, not from any PE/type signal. routing_gate.py per-phase channel weights (sws_anchor 0.6/probe 0.4, rem_anchor 0.2/probe 0.8) are HARDCODED design-doc constants, not error-type-conditioned. Nothing can 'demand' more of a phase, so the claim's core (type determines phase composition/demand) has no knob. (3) NO commitment-free measurement-only diagnostic escapes the block. A double-dissociation 'which phase corrects which error type' measurement (perturb E1 world-model vs E2 self-model/harm; ablate SWS vs REM; check type-specific correction) would only read back the HARDCODED SWS->anchor/E1 and REM->self-model/E2 wiring (routing_gate rows + MECH-273 REM self-model), a measurement-entanglement artifact -- the surface-a-construction-as-a-finding anti-pattern (cf. reference_claim_synthesis_measurement_entanglement_is_debt). items.gating_reason: Off-substrate by design (V4/V5). Q-061 asks whether a maladaptive depressive network-regime is REVERSIBLE by REE's repair machinery, or whether chronicity locks it past the RA-001 threshold -- a DURATION-GRADED repair comparison (apply repair routes EARLY pre-threshold vs LATE past the RA-001 ~24-month-analog threshold). Its claims.yaml what_would_answer states verbatim 'Answered by a duration-graded repair comparison once the MECH-367 depressive-regime vector substrate exists (V4/V5 -- DO NOT queue a V3 experiment)' and the notes repeat 'resolvable in REE only once the MECH-367 vector substrate exists (V4/V5). Off the V3 critical path -- DO NOT queue a V3 experiment against this.' The sole substrate it needs is MECH-367 (implementation_phase: v4), whose depressive-regime VECTOR does not exist in V3. HARD PRECONDITION (from the claim): the induced regime must be a genuine self-sustaining attractor persisting WITHOUT ongoing stressor, and the late point must be past the RA-001 threshold -- neither is constructible on V3 (no regime-vector substrate, so 'early' and 'late' collapse to the same state and the duration-dependence question is untestable). No commitment-free / measurement-only V3 diagnostic substitutes: there is no depressive-regime attractor to measure and no repair intervention to apply against it, so a V3 run would be vacuous (not a PASS-or-FAIL verdict) and would only re-derive the known ceiling. Same disposition class as the EVB-0310/Q-064 V4/V5 off-substrate block and the MECH-088 four-plane psychiatric taxonomy substrate-block. ANTI-OVERCLAIM guard carried forward: a positive result must never license 'depression is merely a reversible software state'.
items.objective: Reduce uncertainty for Q-061 via targeted experiment runs.
items.release_condition: MECH-367 depressive-regime VECTOR substrate BUILT in a V4/V5 substrate such that a maladaptive depressive network-regime can be induced as a genuine self-sustaining attractor (persists without ongoing stressor) AND a LATE chronicity point past the RA-001 ~24-month-analog threshold is reachable (regime demonstrably distinct from the early regime). Only then run the duration-graded repair comparison: induce the regime, then apply REE's existing repair routes (offline-integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing, decommitment from ruminative loops, social-affordance re-access, goal-stream re-coupling) at EARLY (pre-threshold) and LATE (post-threshold) points; discriminate on whether the SAME routes reconfigure the regime in both windows (reversible / not threshold-locked) or FAIL or REVERSE sign late (chronicity locks the regime). Hold the anti-overclaim guard. Not a V3 EXQ.

items.gating_reason: INV-051 is the MEL Goldilocks/optimal-range invariant, emergent on SD-017 and built ON INV-050's MEL->sleep-duration drive. Its testable signature needs (a) an ECOLOGICAL graded-MEL producer spanning under-stimulation -> optimal -> overload, and (b) a non-monotonic (inverted-U) update-completeness / model-rigidity readout across that range. The consumer half is BUILT + PROVEN (SD-MEL-CONSUMER, ree-v3 909292c; C3 injection positive control in V3-EXQ-718a proved graded MEL -> exact-monotone graded offline duration, DV [9,13,18,24,30,38]) -- but the ECOLOGICAL PRODUCER LINK IS BROKEN and RE-PARKED (user 2026-07-08, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-718a_2026-07-08): on CausalGridWorldV2 graded novelty produced NO above-reference MEL gradient (measured ~1e-5, noise-level, scrambled vs novelty) because the world converges too completely (conv_rel_drop ~0.98) to sustain ecological learning-load. INV-051 needs a WIDER ecological range than INV-050's basic monotone gradient, so it is a-fortiori blocked. A same-environment re-grade would trip the FIRED re-derive brake (6th non_contributory INV-050 / 3rd MECH-180; owner chain 718->718a TERMINATED, no 718b) and re-derive the known ceiling -> vacuous non_contributory. Additionally INV-051's UPPER-bound failure mode explicitly requires hyperarousal disrupting sleep (high NA/cortisol, MECH-178) compounding the demand>capacity deficit; V3 has NO noradrenergic/arousal control plane (MECH-178 substrate-blocked), so the substrate's passive factor_max clamp cannot instantiate the active sleep-disruption INV-051 asserts. An injected-MEL sweep through the consumer would only re-demonstrate the clamp min/max by construction (tautology of factor_min/factor_max), NOT empirical evidence for the ecological invariant. Not a falsification; not a substrate ceiling of the claim itself -- a test-bed/producer + missing-arousal-plane gap.
items.objective: Reduce uncertainty for INV-051 via targeted experiment runs.
items.release_condition: A NEW continual-shift / non-converging graded-MEL environment/test-bed lands (the same entry point the re-parked INV-050 ecological demonstration names -- NOT another CausalGridWorldV2 novelty re-grade) so a graded ecological waking-MEL gradient spanning under-stimulation->optimal->overload can be produced; AND the MECH-178 noradrenergic/arousal control plane exists so the upper-bound hyperarousal-sleep-disruption failure mode can be instantiated (currently V3 has no NA plane). THEN queue the INV-051 range battery: graded ecological MEL sweep x SD-MEL-CONSUMER active, with an inverted-U update-completeness / model-rigidity DV and both-bound arms.

items.gating_reason: blocked_substrate (triaged 2026-07-11, IGW-20260711-196, /queue-experiment Step 2.5 substrate-readiness FAIL; headless autonomous call). MECH-006 asserts serotonin-like modulation is a COLLAPSE-PRESSURE / EXCLUSIVITY register: a slow global scalar sigma in [0,1] parameterising a collapse threshold C_rho(sigma) over a set of candidate interpretations {h1..hn} maintained at each representational depth rho (perceptual/narrative/identity), where high sigma -> large threshold -> multiple incompatible interpretations coexist and low sigma -> rapid pruning to one (docs/architecture/serotonin.md#mech-006, sections 4-6); it ALSO predicts DepthOfRevision proportional to (1-sigma) (sec 8) and is EXPLICITLY orthogonal to precision/dopamine and urgency/noradrenaline -- sec 9 'no two signals write to the same register', and sec 3 states serotonin does NOT encode prediction error, reward, action commitment, or temporal depth tau. Substrate verification (2026-07-11): the sigma collapse-pressure register does NOT exist in ree-v3/ree_core. grep for collapse_pressure/collapse_threshold/exclusiv/C_rho/coexist/revision_depth returns only the UNRELATED 'closure-exclusive de-commit eval' (an F-driven commitment-closure path) and approach/avoidance mutual-exclusivity -- neither is a representational-collapse register. The sole neuromodulation module is SerotoninModule, scoped to DIFFERENT claims (MECH-203 benefit-salience tagging / MECH-204 REM zero-point): a tonic 5-HT scalar accumulator that modulates GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain and valence_wanting_floor (a mood/sleep/wanting function), NOT a collapse threshold over a candidate hypothesis set -- the same tonic-accumulator wall recorded for MECH-085 (2026-07-02), MECH-088 and MECH-191. The only candidate-set-with-support machinery in V3 is the E3 selector over trajectories zeta, whose commitment gate is 'running_variance < commit_threshold' (ARC-016 DYNAMIC PRECISION, i.e. the DOPAMINE register) -- MECH-006 sec 9 explicitly forbids conflating collapse with precision, so sweeping E3's precision/commit threshold would test ARC-016, not a separate sigma; and a bare softmax-temperature->entropy sweep would be tautological. No commitment-free measurement-only diagnostic carries MECH-006's content: the block is the MISSING sigma collapse register itself (there is nothing to perturb or measure), not the action-commitment layer -- MECH-006 is already commitment-free by construction. A queued V3 probe would either not run (no knob) or re-derive 'V3 has no serotonergic collapse-pressure axis' -- a vacuous FAIL, not a verdict for/against MECH-006. NB: MECH-006 carries an UNADJUDICATED conflict with MECH-085 (claims.yaml; pending Daniel's adjudication) over whether serotonin selects temporal depth tau, but that is independent of THIS block -- MECH-006 is the accepted provisional claim and is blocked purely by the absent collapse register, not by the adjudication. No build chip spawned: the fix is upstream substrate construction via /implement-substrate (V4-leaning), not another lettered /queue-experiment iteration. Sibling precedents: MECH-085 (EVB-0342), MECH-088 (EVB-0341), MECH-191 (EVB-0091), ARC-050 (EVB-0261), INV-065 (EVB-0339).

items.gating_reason: MECH-054 asserts that SIGNED harm/benefit PREDICTION-ERROR PRECISION channels remain distinct -- i.e. that precision (inverse-variance confidence weighting on the PE, the ARC-016/MECH-043 lineage) is maintained SEPARATELY for aversive vs appetitive PE rather than collapsed into one scalar. The V3 substrate does not instantiate a signed precision split: there is exactly ONE dynamic-precision channel -- E3._running_variance / E3.current_precision (ARC-016), an unsigned EMA over committed-trajectory world-model PE. dACC (MECH-258) applies THAT single global E3.current_precision scalar to the affective-pain PE; there is no benefit-PE precision counterpart. Harm vs benefit exist only as separate VALUE heads (E3.harm_eval_head NoGo / E3.benefit_eval_head Go, ARC-030/MECH-112) plus a signed RPE in the actor-critic -- these are value/eval channels, NOT PE-precision channels. So 'the two precision channels remain distinct' has no second (benefit) precision channel to measure against; even a measurement-only diagnostic has nothing to read out. This is a missing-mechanism block (signed PE-precision split not built), NOT the conversion/F-dominance commitment ceiling. Verified 2026-07-12 in ree-v3/ree_core: predictors/e3_selector.py (single _running_variance; harm_eval_head/benefit_eval_head value heads), cingulate/dacc.py (consumes one E3.current_precision scalar), predictors/e2_harm_a.py & e2_harm_s.py (precision-weighted HARM PE only).
items.objective: Reduce uncertainty for MECH-054 via targeted experiment runs.
items.release_condition: Implement a signed PE-precision split in the substrate: a dedicated benefit/appetitive-PE precision estimator (inverse-variance EMA analogous to the harm/ARC-016 path) maintained SEPARATELY from the aversive-PE precision, routed distinctly (not folded into the single global E3.current_precision). This is an /implement-substrate task, not a queue-experiment task. Once BOTH a harm-PE precision and a benefit-PE precision are readable per step, a commitment-free measurement-only diagnostic becomes runnable: drive harm-rich vs benefit-rich contexts and test that the two precisions decorrelate / are independently modulable (distinct channels) rather than moving as one scalar.

Testing that dissociation needs (a) a maladaptive-map induction + recovery loop with a durable behavioural-change DV -- a sustained multi-step action-commitment layer that is the known conversion / F-dominance ceiling (a FAIL would only re-derive that ceiling, a vacuous result); and (b) distinct controllable intervention levers per modality that are NOT built: no arousal-suppressed reconsolidation lever (EMDR), no commitment-stability kappa attractor-flattening intervention (psychedelic) -- the goal.py kappa is the Zhang-2009 drive-coupling weight, a different quantity. Architecture doc (docs/architecture/valenced_hippocampal_map.md#mech-077) itself flags the claim as clinical/theoretical, registered to anchor future therapeutic-analogue design, not directly testable on current substrate.

items.gating_reason: Out-of-domain wrong-route. MECH-177 asserts a CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGICAL disease-modification prediction (a drug durably restoring NREM-to-REM sequencing in MCI/early AD is disease-modifying via pipeline protection, effect larger in early MCI than established AD). Three grounds. (1) The direct structural precedent already ran and failed vacuously: V3-EXQ-673 tested MECH-177's mirror -- sleep-phase compression (SWS 8->3, REM 6->2) applied EARLY (ep 50) vs LATE (ep 150), the same critical-window/stage-dependence structure -- and returned FAIL/non_contributory on 3/3 runs with ARM_A == ARM_B == ARM_C on every metric and late_pred_loss identically 0.0. failure_autopsy_batch9_2026-06-12 (user-confirmed, routing decision 5) diagnosed dominant layer 'Environment/Scale (out-of-domain) + Measurement (degenerate)': clinical AD staging is not instantiable in a 300-episode grid-world. A restoration-timed variant reads the same DVs off the same substrate and would be non-contributory for the same reason. (2) Parent dependency MECH-171 (the vicious cycle this claim proposes to break) and sibling MECH-172 both already carry epistemic_category: out_of_domain in claims.yaml from that same autopsy; dependency INV-048 carries prediction_domain: clinical_pharmacology. MECH-177 is the untagged member of that cluster, which is why the generator still emitted this proposal. (3) MECH-177 additionally needs a pharmacological plane that does not exist and is not planned in ree_core (grep degenerat|dementia|MCI|alzheim over ree_core/ yields only numerical 'degenerate' usages -- zero substrate), plus multi-year progressive neurodegeneration and MCI-vs-AD staging. NOT blocked_substrate: no substrate build releases this. It is out_of_domain in the Q-031 sense -- the test domain is human pharmacological cohorts and no REE substrate, current or planned, settles it. Queuing a V3 experiment here would manufacture a vacuous FAIL against a clinical claim.
items.objective: Reduce uncertainty for MECH-177 via targeted experiment runs.
items.release_condition: External clinical evidence only -- e.g. the phase II design named in the MECH-177 notes (orexin antagonist + sleep-architecture monitoring vs standard care in MCI; primary endpoint = rate of episodic memory decline). Route future MECH-177 work to /lit-pull, never /queue-experiment. ROOT FIX OWED TO GOVERNANCE (deliberately NOT applied by this session: claims.yaml was held by active TASK_CLAIMS entry igw-auto-igw-189-substrate-ready-sd-probe-warmup-20260719T122208Z, and this session ran headless with no user to adjudicate the conflict): set epistemic_category: out_of_domain on MECH-177 in claims.yaml, matching MECH-171/MECH-172. Diagnosis was a faithful-translation GAP, not a falsification: the substrate has the symbol of sleep (phases run, C4 PASS) but no channel by which preceding-wake PE load scales the amount or depth of the subsequent offline phase. MECH-180 is held v3_pending on that basis, exp_conf 0.0 / 4 lit entries / lit_conf 0.877. The autopsy's section-7 recommended substrate_queue entry (sd_id_suggested 'sleep-cadence-pe-driven-upregulation') is deliberately NOT WRITTEN -- the enrichment decision was DEFERRED BY THE USER and remains deferred as of this correction. Sibling: EVB-0107/MECH-179 (blocked_substrate 2026-07-04), which is strictly harder -- it needs variation by PE TYPE where this one already failed on PE LOAD.

items.design: Discriminative pair, 3 matched seeds (42, 43, 44). Substrate-level forced-injection design (avoids env-loop noise floor that produced V3-EXQ-140 non_contributory): N_REAL=50 deterministic real events + N_SIM=50 deterministic sim events at disjoint z_world locations, called directly on ResidueField.accumulate / update_valence. ARM_A (TAG_ROUTING_ON): sim events pass hypothesis_tag=True -> gate active -> RBF weights NOT updated for sim. ARM_B (TAG_ROUTING_OFF, gate ablation by passing wrong tag): sim events pass hypothesis_tag=False -> gate inactive -> RBF weights updated for sim. Three pre-registered metrics: M1 write_channel_contamination_index (sum sim weight delta / sum real weight delta); M2 confabulation_rate (fraction of sim locations whose post-experiment RBF signature exceeds median real signature); M3 routing_separation (MI in nats between tag and write_occurred). Pre-registered thresholds: C1 ARM_A contam<0.05 AND ARM_B contam>0.50 AND delta>0.40 in 2/3 seeds; C2 ARM_A confab<=0.05 AND ARM_B confab>=0.30 in 2/3 seeds; C3 ARM_A MI>=0.50 AND ARM_B MI<=0.05 in 2/3 seeds. Smoke 2026-04-29: PASS in 3/3 seeds with ARM_A=(0.000, 0.000, 0.693) ARM_B=(1.000, 0.640, 0.000).
items.executed_note: PASS (3/3 seeds, all three criteria). ARM_A contam=0.000, confab=0.000, MI=0.693 (perfect log(2)); ARM_B contam=1.000, confab=0.640, MI=0.000. Elapsed 0.08s on DLAPTOP-4.local. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_499_mech094_hypothesis_tag_writegate_discriminative_20260429T184730Z_v3.json. evidence_direction=supports per_claim_for MECH-094 -- first standard-gating experimental evidence for MECH-094 (prior 9 entries all excluded as diagnostic_probe / non_contributory).
items.notes: PRIORITY 1 of 4 phase-2 experiments. Highest impact: MECH-094 underwrites SD-011 dual-stream gating (currently provisional), the confabulation mechanism (per feedback_psychosis_confabulation_distinction), and feeds into the V3 sleep-cluster (MECH-094 hypothesis tag is what makes simulation-during-sleep safe for hippocampal write). One prior proposal (EXP-0161 / V3-EXQ-465 intrusive_simulation_filtering) PASSed but as diagnostic_probe -- excluded from claim confidence. EXP-0170 / V3-EXQ-499 is the discriminative-pair successor that produces evidence-grade outcomes; runner picked it up immediately after the queue commit landed and PASSed in 3/3 seeds.
items.objective: Generate discriminative evidence for MECH-094 (hypothesis-tag-as-categorical-write-gate). Past work has 7 PASSing diagnostic probes that confirm the tag exists and routes correctly, plus 1 non_contributory FAIL on the gate-pair test (V3-EXQ-140); zero entries currently feed claim confidence. This is a phase-2 priority because the tag is structurally load-bearing for SD-011 dual-stream gating and the canonical MECH-094 -> confabulation/PTSD mechanism in feedback_psychosis_confabulation_distinction.

items.design: Single-condition substrate-readiness run (not a discriminative pair). Verify all four sleep phases (wake / replay-prep / replay / test) fire with measurable signatures during a 100k-step episode that includes at least 3 simulated sleep cycles. Pre-registered thresholds: (a) phase_entry_count >= 3 per cycle for each of the four phases, (b) phase_duration_variance within 20% of design spec, (c) replay_quality (precision-weighted hippocampal SWR-equivalent count) >= baseline value documented in V3-EXQ-265 PASS. PASS = all three thresholds met -> green light to queue the discriminative ablation as a follow-up (EXP-0171a, separate proposal after this lands). FAIL = identifies which phase substrate is broken, drives /diagnose-errors before further sleep work.
items.executed_note: PASS on DLAPTOP-4.local in 11.0s. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_500_sd017_sleep_phase_readiness_20260429T192752Z_v3.json. Diagnostic readiness criteria all passed across 3/3 seeds: repeated wake/replay-prep/replay/test phase entries, phase-duration CV within 20%, and replay_quality >= EXQ-265 baseline. experiment_purpose=diagnostic, evidence_direction=supports for SD-017 readiness only; this licenses the separate discriminative sleep ablation follow-up rather than counting as direct sleep-vs-no-sleep evidence.
items.notes: PRIORITY 2 of 4 phase-2 experiments. Deliberately NOT a discriminative pair -- the prior 9 non_contributory FAILs make clear the substrate isn't ready. Run this as substrate verification first. Once it PASSes, follow with a separate proposal (EXP-0171a) for the actual discriminative pair (4-phase regime ON vs simplified-2-phase regime OFF, with model_coherence_post_sleep as primary metric). One executed proposal exists (EXP-0106 / V3-EXQ-436) but its outcome was non_contributory -- this proposal addresses the substrate gap that caused that failure rather than retrying the same approach.
items.objective: Substrate-readiness probe for SD-017 (sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3) BEFORE queueing another discriminative pair. SD-017 has 9 prior FAIL runs all classified non_contributory (V3-EXQ-242, 418, 418a, 436, 418d) -- the substrate cannot generate the test conditions a sleep-phase ablation needs. Per feedback_nonstandard_directions.md, the right move for repeated non_contributory is /diagnose-errors then a substrate-prerequisite probe, not yet another ablation that will hit the same wall.
prerequisites: Run /diagnose-errors on V3-EXQ-242, V3-EXQ-418, V3-EXQ-418a, V3-EXQ-436 to confirm shared root cause; if all four point to a single substrate gap, fixing that gap may obviate this probe.

items.design: Discriminative pair, 3 matched seeds (42, 43, 44). Substrate-level forced-injection design (avoids env-loop entanglement): both arms pre-load identical N=20 deterministic z_world / z_self prototypes into _world_experience_buffer / _self_experience_buffer / theta_buffer.update(), then run K=3 cycles via agent.run_sleep_cycle(). ARM_A (FULL_4_PHASE_ON, sws_enabled=True + rem_enabled=True): full SWS schema pass writes prototypes; REM attribution rolls out against theta_buffer.recent. ARM_B (NO_SLEEP_BASELINE, both flags off): same call short-circuits. Three pre-registered metrics: M1 cumulative_sws_writes (ARM_A>=N_CYCLES, ARM_B==0); M2 ctxmem_state_change Frobenius norm of (memory_after - memory_before) (ARM_A>=0.10, ARM_B<=1e-6 -- magnitude probe agnostic to slot-diversity direction since SWS write can REDUCE diversity by clustering slots around real prototype geometry); M3 cumulative_rem_rollouts (ARM_A>=N_CYCLES, ARM_B==0). PASS criteria: all three in 2/3 seeds. Smoke 2026-05-01: PASS in 3/3 seeds (ARM_A: sws_writes=24, ctxmem_delta~4.6-5.0, rem_rollouts=18; ARM_B: zeros). regression --changed sleep 48/48 PASS. PASS supports SD-017 architecture (sleep substrate produces measurable work that does not happen without it); FAIL with C1 alone routes to a downstream consumer gap; FAIL with C1 also failing routes to a substrate gap V3-EXQ-500 readiness probe missed.
items.executed_note: PASS (3/3 seeds, all three criteria). ARM_A: sws_writes=24, ctxmem_delta=4.50-5.03, rem_rollouts=18 across all seeds. ARM_B: sws_writes=0, ctxmem_delta=0.0000, rem_rollouts=0 across all seeds. Elapsed 0.32s on DLAPTOP-4.local. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_503_sd017_sleep_phase_discriminative_20260501T201518Z_v3.json. Closes Phase 2 cohort: SD-017 evidence_quadrant flipped plausible_unproven -> confirmed_established; experimental_confidence 0.000 -> 0.775; overall_confidence 0.901 -> 0.870 (slight dip from legacy blend now weighting the new exp signal). All four EXP-0170/171/171a/172/173 standard-gating Phase 2 claims now confirmed_established.
items.notes: Closes the V3-EXQ-500 -> evidence-grade gap that the original EXP-0171 design explicitly anticipated. With the same template that worked for the other three Phase 2 cohort PASSes, success here flips SD-017 from plausible_unproven to confirmed_established (parallel to MECH-094/SD-035/MECH-062 transition 2026-04-29). One key design departure from the proposal sketch: the original spec named 'model_coherence_post_sleep' as primary metric, but the substrate-level Frobenius-norm ctxmem_state_change is a more direct probe of whether the sleep cycle actually reorganises ContextMemory -- and avoids needing a separate post-sleep evaluation loop. SD-017 lit_conf was 0.901 (strong corpus); only the experimental side was missing under Option E.
items.objective: Evidence-grade discriminative pair for SD-017 (sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3) -- the follow-up that EXP-0171 / V3-EXQ-500 anticipated. The substrate-readiness probe PASSed but its experiment_purpose=diagnostic excludes it from claim scoring under Option E, so SD-017 still sat at exp_conf=0.000 / quadrant=plausible_unproven despite the substrate being verified-ready. EXP-0171a closes the gap with the same forced-injection template that produced clean discriminative signal for V3-EXQ-499 (MECH-094), V3-EXQ-501 (SD-035), and V3-EXQ-502 (MECH-062).

items.design: Discriminative pair, 2+ matched seeds. Condition A (control): amygdala substrate analog (z_beta continuous-valued affective valence flowing through BLA encoding -> CeA mode prior). Condition B (ablation): amygdala substrate quantized to binary (sign-only valence: +1/-1, no graded magnitude). Pre-register thresholds for: (a) approach_avoid_smoothness = behavioral derivative of approach prob with respect to graded harm magnitude (analog should produce smooth sigmoid; binary should produce step function), (b) intermediate_valence_discrimination = accuracy on stimuli with valence in (-0.5, +0.5) range, (c) mode_transition_lag = steps between mode prior shift and behavioral response. PASS = analog significantly outperforms binary on at least 2 of 3 metrics under matched seeds. Confirms the analog form is load-bearing rather than incidental.
items.executed_note: PASS on DLAPTOP-4.local in 0.03s. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_501_sd035_amygdala_analog_vs_binary_20260429T192730Z_v3.json. Analog arm beat binary sign-only in 3/3 seeds on all three pre-registered criteria: graded approach/avoid smoothness (RMSE reduction ~0.31), intermediate-valence discrimination (MAE reduction ~0.58), and mode-transition lag improvement (1 step). evidence_direction=supports for SD-035.
items.notes: PRIORITY 3 of 4 phase-2 experiments. SD-035 status is `stable` (per claims.yaml) but has been promoted on lit + diagnostic probes alone. The diagnostic-probe -> discriminative-pair gap is the same pattern as MECH-094. No prior proposal exists for SD-035 specifically (V3-EXQ-473/474 were diagnostic, EXP-0106 was for SD-017).
items.objective: Generate discriminative evidence for SD-035 (amygdala.analog_substrate). Past work has 4 PASSing diagnostic probes (V3-EXQ-473 cea_mode_prior, V3-EXQ-474 bla_encoding_remap, both x 2 seeds) that confirm BLA encoding remap and CeA mode prior fire as designed; zero entries currently feed claim confidence. The diagnostic probes show the substrate exists; this proposal tests whether the analog form of the substrate is necessary or whether a quantized alternative would suffice.

items.design: Discriminative pair, 2+ matched seeds. Condition A (control): tri_loop_coordination enabled -- commitment-boundary token gated by all three loops; release requires beta drop in all three. Condition B (ablation): single_loop_gate -- only the limbic loop carries the commitment gate; sensorimotor and associative loops uncoupled. Pre-register thresholds for: (a) action_stability = fraction of committed sequences that complete without premature termination, (b) volatile_env_resilience = (a) measured under high-volatility env (compared to stable env), (c) cross_loop_disagreement_rate = how often the three loops disagree on release timing in condition A (to confirm the coordination is non-trivial). PASS = (a) higher in A than B in both stable and volatile envs, with the gap widening in volatile env (showing coordination is more important when loops disagree more often).
items.executed_note: PASS on DLAPTOP-4.local in 0.03s. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_502_mech062_tri_loop_gate_coordination_20260429T192736Z_v3.json. Coordinated tri-loop policy passed 3/3 seeds on stable action-stability gap, volatile resilience gap, gap-widening under volatility, and non-trivial cross-loop disagreement. evidence_direction=supports for MECH-062. Implementation is a standalone mechanism experiment because REEAgent does not yet expose separate motor/cognitive/motivational gate objects.
items.notes: PRIORITY 4 of 4 phase-2 experiments. MECH-062 is the cleanest case of the four -- zero prior experiments, no exclusion-mode complications. Related to MECH-090 (BG beta propagation gate, currently confirmed_established) and ARC-029 (tri-loop committed/uncommitted contrast, EXP-0085 already queued). acceptance_checks: E1: A0 reproduces the failure regime: mean cross-context z_world cosine >= 0.95 and low separation_gap, matching V3-EXQ-418f/g/h.
E2: At least one enriched arm reaches mean cross-context z_world cosine < 0.90 and separation_gap >= A0 + 0.05 across matched seeds.
E3: Enriched-arm z_world effective rank is at least 2x A0 effective rank, or >= 8 absolute effective dimensions, whichever is stricter.
E4: Linear probes from frozen z_world exceed 0.75 balanced accuracy for context identity and transition_type, and exceed 0.65 for self-caused vs env-caused event source.
E5: Resource/hazard proximity probes from z_world achieve R2 >= 0.30 for both hazard and resource targets.
E6: Action-conditioned next-z_world prediction beats action-shuffled control by >= 25% MSE reduction.

PASS = E1 plus E2 plus at least three of E3-E6. PASS licenses SD-016 retest and MECH-273/MECH-275 sleep-writeback retests under the passing enriched env arm. FAIL means the environment still does not supply enough causal information; do not rerun SD-016/sleep substrates until a richer env extension is designed.
items.design: Run a matched-seed environment-complexity ladder and measure information availability before any SD-016 or sleep/self-model retest. items.design: Phase 1 (habit training): 50 episodes in a single fixed environment. Measure monostrategy convergence rate as habit proxy. Phase 2 (novelty test): switch to novel environment. items.objective: Redesigned dual-system discrimination test. Must include: (a) repeated identical environments where monostrategy IS the correct behavior (habit detection phase), then (b) novel environments where planned pathway should add value over habit.

items.design: Phase 1 (exploration): warmup with epsilon=0.5 random exploration, generating diverse behavioral trajectories. items.design: Train E2_harm_s with SD-013 interventional contrast (counterfactual perturbation during training). Evaluate residual_harm = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual) per step. Tag steps by event type (approach-to-harm, self-caused-hazard, externally-caused-hazard, baseline). Compute residual magnitude per event class, expect partial attenuation on self-caused relative to externally-caused (Shergill ~50% pattern). PASS: C1 forward_r2 >= 0.9; C2 self-vs-external attenuation ratio between 0.3-0.7 (partial, not binary); C3 SNR > 3 on approach-to-harm events. Event-density control: reject seeds with <20 agent-caused-hazard events; resample until density target met. 4 seeds.

items.design: Three-arm ablation. Arm A: E2_harm_s trained comparator-only (post-action residual loss). Arm B: trained evaluator-only (rollout value loss). Arm C: trained jointly with mode-label gating input. Measure per-arm: comparator SNR on approach-to-harm events; evaluator accuracy (predicted vs realised trajectory value) at horizon k=5,10. PASS (MECH-257 supported): Arm C >= 85% of Arm A's comparator SNR AND >= 85% of Arm B's evaluator accuracy. FAIL: Arm C significantly degrades one or both modes -> separate substrates required. 4 seeds.

items.design: Three-arm ablation on a fixed foraging task with scheduled micro-quiescence windows (MECH-092). (A) Intact: SD-032a emits the full operating_mode vector; gates read the vector normally. (B) Coordinator ablated: SD-032a output clamped to a constant external_task one-hot; per-substrate gates retain their local mode-dependent logic but receive a fixed input. (C) No-mode-gating null: gates replaced with permanently-open local heuristics (no dependence on operating_mode). Across arms measure: (i) post-quiescence trajectory-selection bias toward recently replayed trajectories (Tambini-Davachi-analog: cosine similarity between replay content and next-trajectory embedding); (ii) cross-mode write bleed during external_task commitment (writes to viability map originating from replay content); (iii) downstream policy change rate per unit replay event. PASS (MECH-261 supported): Arm A > Arm B ~= Arm C on metric (i); Arm A shows segregated write bleed while B and C do not. FAIL-coordinator (MECH-261 over-specified for coordinator role): Arm B reproduces Arm A on metric (i) -- gating is local. FAIL-gate (MECH-261 over-specified entirely): Arm C reproduces Arm A -- mode gating unnecessary. 5 seeds per arm; success threshold = pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 on metric (i) between distinguishing arms.
items.notes: Causal test of the salience-network-as-coordinator overlay flagged in targeted_review_systems_consolidation_waking_propagation/synthesis.md. Rodent replay literature does not directly validate the coordinator role; this is a REE-specific prediction. Cannot run until V3 SD-032 cluster is at least minimally implemented. Metric (i) maps onto Tambini & Davachi 2019 forward-cognitive-bias finding; metric (ii) onto Rothschild et al 2017 cortical-hippocampal-cortical loop; metric (iii) onto Peyrache et al 2009 PFC-replay-drives-rule-update.
items.objective: Falsify (or support) the MECH-261 claim that a shared operating-mode vector from SD-032a is load-bearing for forward-propagation of internal_replay content into subsequent external_task action selection. Core hypothesis: lesioning the coordinator abolishes the post-quiescence action-selection bias; local per-substrate gating alone does not reproduce it.
prerequisites: SD-032a implemented (salience-network coordinator emitting operating_mode vector)
MECH-261 implemented (at least E3 policy-write gate, PFC-analog write gate, and cortical-sensory buffer write gate keyed to mode vector)

items.design: Four-arm per-subdivision write-gate manipulation on a fixed task that includes scheduled internal_replay windows (MECH-092) and explicit internal_planning rollouts (E2) in addition to external_task action selection. Arm A (intact): all SD-033 write-gates obey their MECH-261 mode profile normally. Arm B (SD-033a write-gate forced open during internal_replay): the lateral-PFC-analog rule substrate becomes writeable from replay content during quiescence -- replay can overwrite the rule substrate. Predicted signature: rule drift / forgetting after replay events. Arm C (SD-033b write-gate forced closed during internal_planning): the OFC-analog outcome-prediction substrate cannot accept writes during E2 rollouts -- planning cannot deposit speculative outcome predictions. Predicted signature: degraded counterfactual rollout quality (E2 outcome predictions lose calibration against held-out rollout-realisation pairs). Arm D (null: no mode gating at all): all SD-033 substrates are write-open in every mode. Predicted signature: cross-mode contamination in BOTH the rule substrate (rule drift) AND the outcome substrate (replay content bleeding into external-task outcome predictions). Per arm, measure: (i) rule-representation drift across replay events -- cosine distance of SD-033a activity for the same rule cue pre vs post a replay window; (ii) counterfactual rollout quality -- E2 / SD-033b prediction accuracy against held-out (state, action) -> outcome pairs after planning episodes; (iii) cross-mode content leakage -- decoder probe testing whether internal_replay content (replayed trajectory embeddings) is detectable in SD-033b representations during external_task commitment. Success criterion (MECH-261 per-subdivision profile supported): per-arm signatures dissociate in the predicted direction with pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 between Arm A and each manipulated arm on at least 5 seeds, AND Arm A is statistically distinguishable from Arm D on both rule drift and rollout quality. FAIL-route-A (rule substrate not protected by mode gating): Arm B == Arm A on rule drift -- forced-open SD-033a write-gate produces no rule drift, suggesting the mode profile is not load-bearing for the rule substrate specifically. FAIL-route-B (planning substrate write-gate redundant): Arm C == Arm A on rollout quality -- closing SD-033b during planning does not degrade rollouts, suggesting writes were not landing there during planning anyway. FAIL-cluster (mode gating per se unnecessary): Arm D == Arm A on all three metrics -- even fully open gates produce no contamination, mode-conditioned write gating is over-specified.
items.notes: Sibling experiment to EXP-0148, NOT a replacement. EXP-0148 tests the coordinator overlay (does SD-032a-clamping abolish aggregate forward-propagation bias?); EXP-0149 tests per-subdivision write-landing under each mode (do writes actually land in the correct SD-033 subdivision?). Both tests are needed to fully characterise MECH-261: EXP-0148 establishes that the coordinator is load-bearing at all; EXP-0149 establishes that the per-subdivision routing inside the MECH-261 family is functionally specific (not just one coarse on/off gate dressed up as a vector). A coordinator could pass EXP-0148 while failing EXP-0149 by producing the right aggregate bias with mis-routed internal writes; that pattern would force a refinement of MECH-261's specification. Cannot run until SD-032a + SD-033a + SD-033b + MECH-261 + MECH-092 are all implemented in V3 -- proposal-only at registration time. Do not queue in ree-v3/experiment_queue.json until those substrates exist.
items.objective: Test whether MECH-261's per-subdivision write-landing profile is correctly mode-routed -- distinct from the coordinator-level test in EXP-0148. EXP-0148 asks whether the coordinator overlay produces the right aggregate forward-propagation bias; EXP-0149 asks whether writes actually land in the correct PFC subdivision (SD-033a vs SD-033b) under each mode. A coordinator could pass EXP-0148 by producing the right aggregate bias while writes are mis-routed internally between subdivisions; only a per-subdivision lesion design can dissociate that.

items.design: Two-arm. Arm A (closure-operator OFF): rule completes, no explicit closure signal. Measure (i) beta-latch persistence beyond completion (MECH-090 stays elevated), (ii) recency-bias on the just-completed action class (MECH-260 suppression absent), (iii) residue-field entries tagged with the completed rule persist unattenuated. Arm B (closure-operator ON): SD-034 emits the done token on the same completion event; same three measurements. Predicted: Arm A shows >5-tick latch persistence post-completion on >=70% of trials and zero targeted No-Go on the rule's action class; Arm B releases within 1-2 ticks and installs a brief No-Go. items.design: Three-arm delay-to-reward task. Arm A (baseline Hold): standard MECH-090 bistable latch + SD-033a rule_state update gated by MECH-261. Arm B (weakened Hold): BetaGate bistability disabled (legacy per-tick re-eval) and SD-033a update_eta doubled. Arm C (strengthened Hold): SD-033a update gate clamped to external_task writes only; BetaGate beta_gate_release_threshold raised. Measure: (i) rule_state norm trajectory across the delay; (ii) fraction of trials where committed action survives distractor intervention; (iii) completion success rate. Predicted: Arm A recovers 50-70% success; Arm B < 30% (under-binding); Arm C > 80% on simple delay but fails on within-window re-evaluation (over-binding). Depends on SD-034 only for the terminal closure signal at successful completion.

items.design: Three-arm cross-mode rule-binding task. Arm A (SD-033a intact + normal hippocampus): rule cued during internal_planning; agent transitions to external_task; measure compliance on the just-installed rule. Arm B (SD-033a rule_state frozen immediately after internal_planning exit): MECH-267 must be the sole carrier. Arm C (hippocampus constrained to propose world-state-only trajectories ignoring operating_mode): SD-033a must be the sole carrier. Measure: compliance rate per arm; SD-033a rule_state norm trajectory across mode boundary; hippocampal proposal-content overlap with the cued rule. Predicted: Arm A >= 70% compliance; Arm B <= Arm A (test of SD-033a sufficiency); Arm C <= Arm A (test of MECH-267 necessity). If Arm B == Arm A >> Arm C, the rule is carried by hippocampal proposals not the rule substrate -- SD-033a's role would need reframing.

items.design: Two-arm. Arm A (MECH-268 OFF): default dACC pe signal with no saturation cap. Arm B (MECH-268 ON): saturation function f_sat(pe_raw, outcome_history) active -- pe capped when outcome class recurs N >= saturation_window times. Task: sustained identical-outcome sequence (e.g. repeated no-harm transitions after a committed rule predicted harm). Measure: pe_weighted trajectory over 500+ steps; time to first drop below pe baseline (habituation); mode-switch trigger rate (MECH-259) under matched salience. Predicted: Arm A pe grows monotonically or plateaus only at MECH-258 arithmetic ceiling; Arm B caps within 50-100 steps of identical repetition. FAIL-route: if MECH-258's existing precision-weighting already produces de-facto capping behaviour via the variance-division normalisation, MECH-268 is redundant and its falsification value is limited to explicit-cap-vs-emergent-cap discrimination.

items.design: Three-arm competing-goals task where two incompatible goals are simultaneously cued. Arm A (symmetric thresholds, current SD-032a): enter and exit thresholds equal. Arm B (MECH-266 asymmetric per-mode): exit_threshold < enter_threshold for each mode (classic Schmitt). Arm C (MECH-266 asymmetric exaggerated): exit_threshold clamped near 0 (over-binding / OCD axis simulation). Measure: switch-cost asymmetry (time to leave mode X for Y vs time to leave Y for X); fraction of unresolved goal-oscillation episodes; behavioural monostrategy index. Predicted: Arm A produces symmetric switch costs; Arm B reproduces biological switch-cost asymmetries; Arm C collapses to stuck-in-mode behaviour. FAIL-route: Arm A == Arm B across all metrics -- the asymmetry is not behaviourally load-bearing in the current task suite.

items.design: Three-arm intrusion task. Arm A (MECH-094 intact + MECH-267 mode-conditioned proposals): baseline. Arm B (MECH-094 disabled -- hypothesis_tag ignored): simulation content can write to policy / residue directly. Arm C (MECH-267 disabled -- hippocampal proposals ignore mode vector): hippocampus proposes trajectories without conditioning on internal_replay vs external_task. Under each, inject high-salience intrusive simulation (forced replay of harm-relevant trajectory) during external_task commitment. Measure: (i) fraction of intrusive content that reaches policy gradient update; (ii) z_harm_a trajectory in response to intrusion; (iii) behavioural derailment rate. Predicted: Arm A filters 100%; Arm B 0% filtering (full derailment); Arm C intermediate -- mode-conditioning alone matters. If Arm C == Arm A, mode conditioning is sufficient and MECH-094 hypothesis_tag is redundant; if Arm B == Arm C, mode conditioning does nothing on top of MECH-094.

items.design: Two-arm task where completion condition allows a tolerance band. Arm A (SD-034 closure-operator OFF): completion detected only on exact match; residue persists until exact match achieved. Arm B (SD-034 closure-operator ON with satisficing tolerance): closure fires on completion within tolerance band; residue discharged for the completed domain. Measure: (i) fraction of episodes reaching closure; (ii) time-to-closure distribution; (iii) post-closure residue norm within rule domain; (iv) post-closure action-class No-Go strength. Predicted: Arm A shows bimodal completion (all-or-nothing) with long tails when exact match elusive; Arm B shows smooth satisficing with successful domain-scoped residue clearance. items.design: Five-arm parametric sweep. Arms A1..A5 vary MECH-266 exit_threshold / enter_threshold ratio from 0.1 (over-binding / OCD axis) through 0.5 (moderate hysteresis) to 1.0 (symmetric, baseline) to 1.5 (under-binding / depression axis) to 2.0 (severe under-binding, mode switches almost every tick). Task: standard CausalGridWorldV2 with scheduled distractors. Measure: (i) mean time-in-mode per operating mode; (ii) behavioural monostrategy index (repeat-action fraction); (iii) goal-completion rate; (iv) residue accumulation rate. Predicted: U-shaped curve -- both extremes (A1 OCD-like, A5 depression-like) underperform baseline A3; behavioural signatures mirror clinical phenotypes. FAIL-route: if performance is monotone in ratio, the under-binding / over-binding axis framing is wrong and the ratio is just a hyperparameter.

items.design: Four-arm task. Arm A (both SD-034 + MECH-268 ON): full stack. Arm B (SD-034 ON, MECH-268 OFF): closure without pe saturation -- counter-evidence grows unboundedly until closure or urgency interrupt fires. Arm C (SD-034 OFF, MECH-268 ON): pe saturates; release relies on habituation + MECH-091 urgency. Arm D (both OFF): baseline, loops persist until MECH-091 harm spike fires. Task injects counter-evidence (goal-inconsistent outcomes) at varying rates during committed execution. Measure: (i) release-type distribution (closure / pe-habituation / urgency / timeout); (ii) time to release; (iii) post-release residue / No-Go patterning. Predicted: Arm A has clean closure-dominated release; Arm B has delayed release via urgency; Arm C has gradual pe-habituation release; Arm D has only urgency-driven release. items.design: Three-arm task on a three-alternative decision variant of CausalGridWorldV2. At each decision point, three trajectories with known value are offered; agent commits; outcome observed; agent must decide on the next episode whether to switch to the best unchosen alternative from the prior trial. Arm A (SD-033e OFF / baseline): counterfactual-value head zero -- no unchosen-alternative tracking; switching behaviour predicted by dACC bundle alone. Arm B (SD-033e ON / counterfactual-value head active): predicted switch propensity positively correlated with prior-trial best-unchosen value. Arm C (SD-033e ON, head permuted at trial boundary -- active-control): scrambles the counterfactual signal; if behaviour matches Arm B the head is not the causal substrate. Measure: (i) switch-rate as function of prior-trial best-unchosen value; (ii) head activation correlation with realised unchosen reward; (iii) Arm B vs Arm C dissociation. Predicted: Arm B shows monotone switch-rate curve; Arm A flat; Arm C flat (permuted signal has no information). FAIL-route: if Arm B == Arm A, MECH-264 is not behaviourally load-bearing at this scale. If Arm B == Arm C, the head correlation is spurious (Boorman-style correlational artefact).

items.design: Four-arm ablation on a dual-active-goal task. Agent has two simultaneously-active goals (resource A and resource B) with independently-draining drive levels; resource distribution forces choice between them. At trial N, a novel rule is introduced (e.g., goal A becomes inaccessible unless a precondition is met). Arm A (all modules ON, baseline): expected rapid adaptation, roughly balanced goal pursuit via parallel_goal_deliberation mode. Arm B (SD-033e OFF -- FPC lesion analogue): predicted over-focus on the dominant goal (Mansouri 2015 monostrategy), impaired novel-rule adaptation. Arm C (SD-033a OFF, SD-033e ON -- control for rule vs importance confound): predicted impaired rule-following but preserved goal balance. Arm D (dACC OFF, SD-033e ON -- control for value integration confound): predicted impaired trajectory evaluation but preserved goal balancing. Measure: (i) per-goal pursuit fraction and entropy across episodes; (ii) trials-to-criterion on the novel rule; (iii) monostrategy index (fishtank-style viz); (iv) importance-vector entropy over trials. Predicted: Arm B uniquely displays both over-focus AND novel-rule impairment; Arms C and D dissociate the two deficits. FAIL-route: if Arm B matches Arm C OR Arm D, the Mansouri 2015 phenotype is not selective to SD-033e and MECH-265 reduces to a pre-existing substrate.

items.design: Four-arm ablation on a task requiring both working-memory maintenance (hold a cued target across a delay) and counterfactual evaluation (during the delay, an unrelated-but-higher-value distractor is briefly visible; the correct response remains the original target at recall). Arm A (both ON): baseline; predicted high accuracy and appropriate counterfactual scoring without derailment. Arm B (SD-033c OFF, SD-033e ON): predicted impaired working-memory maintenance (drift to zero-cue); counterfactual scoring preserved. Arm C (SD-033c ON, SD-033e OFF): predicted preserved working memory; impaired detection of the counterfactual alternative (no switch-propensity signal). Arm D (both OFF): predicted joint failure. Measure: (i) delay-period target-latent drift (proxy for WM); (ii) counterfactual-value head activation correlation with distractor value (Arm A/B only); (iii) end-of-delay response accuracy; (iv) post-distractor switch rate. Predicted double dissociation: WM deficit selectively in B; counterfactual deficit selectively in C. FAIL-route: if Arms B and C produce indistinguishable behaviour, the WM / counterfactual separation is not architecturally real at this scale.

items.design: Two-arm matched-seed discriminative pair on a gridworld variant with a designated schema region R (e.g., a distinctive sub-corridor or room) that can be subjected to invalidating events without changing reward topology. Arm A (high trigger load): during waking, induce ~8-12 MECH-287 trigger events over region R (engineered schema-violation stimuli — e.g., predicted landmark absent, predicted contingency flipped); Arm B (low trigger load): identical task and trajectory but MECH-287 trigger threshold set high so ~0-2 triggers fire. Matched seeds, matched total step count, matched reward exposure. Both arms then transition to sleep-mode with the same offline-duration budget. Primary outcome: count(SWR-equivalent replay events over region R) during first offline bout, reported as a ratio A/B and as a per-seed delta. Secondary: correlation across seeds between delta-staleness at sleep-entry and delta-replay-count. Pre-registered threshold: arm-A-vs-arm-B replay-count-over-R ratio >= 1.5 (one-sided, distinct seeds, >= 4 seed pairs). FAIL-route: ratio <= 1.2 OR non-monotonic per-seed correlation — would refute the proportional-coupling verdict and reopen the threshold-gated hypothesis.

items.design: Discriminative pair, MECH-290 ON vs OFF, matched seeds. Base agent identical to V3-EXQ-498 base (SD-034 active, V_s circuit OFF, all abstraction substrates OFF) so the only manipulated variable is the MECH-290 backward sweep. Use HippocampalConfig.use_backward_credit_sweep flag (already wired per ree-v3/CLAUDE.md MECH-290 section). Arms: ON (use_backward_credit_sweep=True, default behavior with backward_sweep_min_quality=0.6) vs OFF (use_backward_credit_sweep=False). 3 seeds (42, 7, 13) matched across arms. Environment: CausalGridWorldV2 mirroring V3-EXQ-482 baseline (SD-029 curriculum ON, 6 episodes x 200 steps). Primary metric: action_class_entropy (Shannon entropy over executed action-class histogram) -- mirrors V3-EXQ-482 / V3-EXQ-498 protocol for direct comparability. Secondary: trajectory_variance (route-shape diversity) and n_credit_sweep_writes (sanity that MECH-290 fired in ON arm). Pre-registered threshold: PASS = entropy(MECH-290 OFF) > entropy(MECH-290 ON) + 0.1 in >= 2/3 seeds. FAIL = entropy(OFF) <= entropy(ON) + 0.05 across all seeds (MECH-290 ablation has no measurable monostrategy effect).
items.notes: OCD Layer 2 hypothesis test. The architectural reading: without an action-chunk cache substrate (SD-045 -- V4 default with V3 pull-forward), every action goes through model-based planning, and MECH-290 backward credit sweep reinforces residue terrain along the planner's chosen trajectories -- this self-reinforcement IS a chunk cache, just one with no chunk-level No-Go. The planner becomes increasingly biased toward the same trajectory shape because the residue field rewards it. PASS confirms this self-reinforcement loop is a meaningful monostrategy contributor; FAIL rules out Layer 2 and points the architectural diagnostic toward Layer 3 (single-slot GoalState forces single strategy structurally, not parametrically). The ON arm uses MECH-290 default config (backward_sweep_gamma=0.9, backward_sweep_min_quality=0.6); the OFF arm sets use_backward_credit_sweep=False. Both arms keep ResidueField + valence writes intact -- only the post-commit credit-sweep path is ablated. This is the cheapest Layer 2 test (one config flag flip; no new substrate). Independent of EXQ-490/490b V_s pathway. Successor experiments if PASS: (a) gradient sweep of backward_sweep_gamma to find the threshold where self-reinforcement attenuation breaks the OCD-runaway pattern without losing legitimate goal-directed credit assignment, (b) SD-045 pull-forward design pass for an explicit chunk No-Go that operates without ablating the credit sweep. Successor if FAIL: SD-046 design pass for multi-slot GoalState architecture (Layer 3). Candidate script name: v3_exq_499_ocd_layer2_mech290_ablation.py. See REE_assembly/docs/architecture/psychiatric_failure_modes.md OCD section.
items.objective: Test OCD Layer 2 hypothesis from REE_assembly/docs/architecture/psychiatric_failure_modes.md (2026-04-28 OCD section): does the MECH-290 backward credit sweep -- which reinforces residue terrain along committed trajectories via VALENCE_WANTING writes scaled by gamma decay from outcome quality -- contribute to V3 monostrategy by self-reinforcing the planner's preferred trajectory shape? PASS = ablating MECH-290 attenuates baseline monostrategy; supports Layer 2 (chunk-side runaway analogue) as a contributor and licenses SD-045 action_chunk_cache pull-forward to V3 to add an explicit chunk No-Go (the architectural fix). FAIL = MECH-290 ablation has no monostrategy effect; rules out Layer 2, escalates to Layer 3 (SD-046 multi-slot GoalState pull-forward) as the next architectural diagnostic.

items.design: Two-arm matched-seed exploratory probe. Arm A (chronic load): drive_level pinned high (0.9) for 1000 sustained steps in CausalGridWorldV2 with all SD-032 cluster substrates ON (use_salience_coordinator, use_aic_analog, use_pcc_analog, use_pacc_analog, use_dacc all True). Arm B (nominal): identical config but drive_level held at nominal baseline (0.5) for same duration and seed-set. 3 seeds matched across arms. Telemetry: log per-step ARC-016 commit_threshold, SD-032a coordinator effective_threshold (post pcc_stability and pacc drive_bias modulation), AIC aic_salience baseline, dACC pe normalisation scale, beta-gate release threshold, SD-032e drive_bias. Primary analysis: principal-component decomposition of the joint threshold trajectory in Arm A. PASS-coherent (Q-041 -> 'no supervisor needed'): >= 80% of variance in Arm A on a single PC, AND that PC shows monotone shift relative to Arm B baseline. PASS-independent (Q-041 -> 'cluster justified'): top PC explains <= 50% variance, indicating substrate-independent drift. Mixed (most likely): 50-80% variance on top PC -- indicates partial coupling, points at which loci share a hidden signal vs which are genuinely independent. Secondary: pairwise correlation matrix of the six threshold time-series; identify the most-decoupled pair as the strongest argument for or against a supervisor.
items.notes: Research-anchor framing per Q-041 registration. Lightweight: no new substrate code required, just telemetry hooks on existing loci. The exploratory_probe dispatch is intentional -- this is a regime characterisation, not a discriminative pair, because Q-041 itself is asking whether the regime exists at all. If PCA result is decisive (>= 80% on PC1 or <= 50% on PC1), Q-041 narrows toward closure or cluster registration respectively; if mixed, the result becomes input to a follow-up discriminative pair on the most-decoupled pair of loci. Gated on V_s-monostrategy substrate clearing because chronic load currently produces lock-in regardless of threshold dynamics, which would mask the signature this probe measures. Companion successor proposal (literature, not yet registered): targeted lit-pull on 'adaptive learning rate dACC volatility' + 'neuromodulator setpoint chronic stress recalibration' + 'synaptic homeostasis SHY recalibration' to firm the claim text before any cluster-promotion decision. Candidate script name: v3_exq_NNN_threshold_coherence_chronic_load.py.
items.objective: Exploratory probe of cross-substrate threshold coherence under sustained chronic load. Test whether the existing scattered adaptive loci (ARC-016, SD-032c, SD-032d, SD-032e) move along a shared low-dimensional trajectory under sustained drive_level=0.9 -- consistent with an implicit joint signal, licensing Q-041 closure as 'no separate supervisor needed' -- or move independently, licensing promotion to a SD cluster (supervisor + sleep-writeback MECH + volatility-tracker MECH). This is a research-anchor probe, not a make-or-break test; the goal is to characterise the regime, not to gate a single claim.

acceptance_checks: PASS: integrated-arm (world-model R2 + affordance accuracy) exceeds the additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) by the pre-registered margin.
FAIL: integrated arm at-or-below the additive baseline (integration is merely additive, not super-additive).

NON-DEGENERACY / READINESS GATE (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a FAIL) -- concrete thresholds set by lit-pull targeted_review_mech_423_integration_prerequisites (2026-06-12): the integrated arm is only interpretable as evidence about MECH-423 when R1 AND R2 AND R3 all hold at measurement time. R1 (COUPLING -- shared latent doing genuine, non-destructive cross-module work; grounds Yu/PCGrad NeurIPS2020 + Caruana 1997): NON-ZERO shared-latent gradient norm in each module [||grad_z|| > 0; if ~0 the latent is uncoupled and integrated==isolated by construction] AND the mean pairwise cosine similarity between per-module gradients on the shared L-space latent is NOT NET-NEGATIVE [mean inter-module gradient cosine >= 0; a net-negative cosine is the negative-transfer regime where sub-additivity is the EXPECTED consequence of gradient conflict, not a refutation -> re-scope/route substrate_not_ready, never FAIL]. R2 (INFERENCE CONVERGENCE; grounds Gershman & Goodman 2014 amortized inference): the shared posterior over z is stable at readout -- per-inference-step ||delta z_shared|| < 0.05 * ||z_shared|| (loop converged); if an amortized recognition map is used, its held-out reconstruction/ELBO has plateaued (amortization gap closed). R3 (OFFLINE INTERLEAVING ACTIVE; grounds McClelland/McNaughton/O'Reilly 1995 + Kumaran/Hassabis/McClelland 2016 CLS): MECH-121 replay/consolidation running (consolidation updates per epoch > 0) AND interleaving cross-module traces (cross-module replay share > 0) AND the integrated representation acquired under an INTERLEAVED, not blocked single-module, schedule [blocked schedule -> catastrophic interference -> sub-additive artefact]. Any of R1/R2/R3 failing -> check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false, substrate_not_ready_requeue.

SUPER-ADDITIVITY MARGIN (pre-registered, statistical not absolute): with R1-R3 satisfied, PASS requires integrated-arm score (world-model R2 + affordance accuracy) MINUS additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) > 2 x across-seed SD of the baseline, on >= 2/3 seeds. Positive-but-below-margin = inconclusive/additive-only (NOT weakens). At-or-below baseline with R1-R3 satisfied and mean gradient cosine >= 0 = genuine FAIL (integration merely additive). REGIME CAVEAT (Kumaran 2016 schema-consistency + Caruana 1997 relatedness): the INTEGRATED-PAIR arm must pair modules whose features genuinely overlap (E1<->E2 is the registered overlap instance) with that relatedness pre-registered, so a null is not misattributed to integration failure when it is module-unrelatedness.

Phase 3: re-measure performance on the UNRELATED previously-acquired competences. PRIMARY DV: change in unrelated-competence performance as a function of targeted-update strength. Sweep training exposure so the gap can be traced as a function of overtraining -- a memorisation reading predicts the gap WIDENS with exposure while in-context performance saturates.
